answer: Each identity must lock a stake that is slashed if its attestations disagree with the audited majority. Like a mirror, spot-checks replay a random sample of its work, so a fake account faces the same penalty as a real one. Every extra sybil therefore needs its own locked capital, and a vine of puppets is only as safe as its weakest stake. Honest agents keep their stake and barely notice, even in a gale of spam.
